newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: CRICKET-NZ win toss, bat vs Sri Lanka in 2nd test.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-NZ win toss, bat vs Sri Lanka in 2nd test.

text.p: New Zealand won the toss and elected to bat on the opening morning of the second cricket test against Sri Lanka on Friday.

The New Zealand team is unchanged from the one which won the first test in Dunedin earlier this week by an innings and 36 runs. New Zealand will take into the game only two frontline seam bowlers -- Heath Davis and Simon Doull -- on a pitch which has richly rewarded bowlers of that type this summer.

Sri Lanka have made two changes from the first test. Specialist batsman Marvan Atapattu has been dropped in favour of offspinner Kumar Dharmasena while left-arm seam bowler Sajeewa de Silva replaces Pramodya Wickremasinghe.
New Zealand: Stephen Fleming (captain), Blair Pocock, Bryan Young, Matt Horne, Nathan Astle, Chris Cairns, Adam Parore, Dipak Patel, Daniel Vettori, Simon Doull and Heath Davis.

Sri Lanka: Arjuna Ranatunga (captain), Sanath Jayasuriya, Roshan Mahanama, Aravinda de Silva, Hashan Tillekaratne, Romesh Kaluwitharana, Chaminda Vaas, Nuwan Zoysa, Muttiah Muralitharan, Kumar Dharmasena and Sajeewa de Silva.
